firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently attended a business meeting starts. Play continues clockwise.
officialTieBreak: If tied, choose the starting player randomly.

internalEvidence: The Artipia product page links this 12-page English publisher PDF. Its Setup section on PDF page 2 selects the most recent business-meeting attendee, states random selection in case of a tie, and says play continues clockwise. PDF page 3 confirms sequential turns.
